Topographic survey

A topographic survey records the elevation and the physical features of a site: the ground surface, existing structures, utilities, trees and drainage. Architects and civil engineers use it as the base drawing for a design.

We deliver topographic surveys as a CAD file with a contour interval agreed with your engineer, plus a signed PDF. Most sites under five acres are complete within two weeks.

What is included in a topographic survey?

Spot elevations on a grid, contours at the agreed interval, visible utilities, structures, pavement edges and significant vegetation. Underground utilities are shown only where a locate service has marked them.
